description: The post -> BIO-link -> commission -> record path is a set of disconnected parts, not an end-to-end wire. build-link.mjs PRODUCES an affiliate URL but NOTHING sets it into an account BIO (no BIO-update automation exists in skills/earn/affiliate/ or referenced by any loop). amazon_report.py and record-affiliate-earn.mjs (INV-7) exist but are invoked by NO loop — there is no run.sh or core to call them, so commission is never measured or recorded automatically. record-affiliate-earn.mjs:22 also writes to ~/.smtm/earn-loops/affiliate/ while the clip ledger lives under ~/.openclaw/state and the spec narrative says 'record (earn_usdc 0)'; the ledger location/integration is not reconciled with the slot. The money path therefore cannot complete unattended even once the account exists.

evidence.snippet: const LEDGER_DIR = join(homedir(), ".smtm", "earn-loops", "affiliate"); // invoked by no loop; no BIO-set automation exists
